title: June 2026 Regulatory Review
summary: June was shaped by the FCA's continued build-out of the future UK cryptoasset regime, further MiCA supervisory work in the European Union and global institutional analysis of tokenisation, stablecoins and settlement architecture.
note: Editorial review based on monitored public regulatory and institutional sources. MVP First Release v1.0 adds RSS-first monitoring automation, a source registry and corporate-safe informational metadata.
